provenance.buildNote: Single-threaded wasi-sdk 33 build (CMake, target 'shell'); Z3_SINGLE_THREADED + Z3_POLLING_TIMER; C++ exceptions via -fwasm-exceptions (-wasm-use-legacy-eh=false, -lunwind), LTO off (wasi-sdk #629). WASM lacks fenv rounding modes (force-include shim defines FE_UPWARD/DOWNWARD/TOWARDZERO for hwf.cpp) and signals/mmap/fork (wasi-emulated-signal/mman/process-clocks/getpid + pthread_atfork no-op stub). wasm-opt -Oz + strip. No threads/SAB. Built + smoke-tested 8/8 goldens on arm64 via build/z3/.
